name: cache-warmer
description: One button under ✦ enhance, 🔥 with keep-warm on or ❄ with it off, beside how long the prompt cache stays warm and the pings sent: while you are away it re-reads the cache with a one-word fork a few minutes before it expires, so your next prompt is not billed the whole conversation again.

leadMinutes.title: Ping lead
leadMinutes.description: How many minutes before the cache expires the ping is sent.

maxIdleHours.title: Stop after
maxIdleHours.description: Hours without a turn of yours after which pinging stops, so a session left open overnight does not keep spending. The next turn starts it again.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each request. auto: what the engine says on a model switch, or 5m once a fork finds the cache lapsed early; before either, 1h on a Claude subscription (rate limits reported) and 5m otherwise. 5m or 1h to set it.
